result.title: Conditional Diffusion Models for Amortized Bayesian System Identification
result.summary: Generative diffusion models rapidly solve Bayesian inverse problems, such as image restoration and inpainting, with a single trained model and without retraining for each new observation or task. Bayesian system identification, which typically involves inferring the hidden states and parameters of a dynamical system from measurements, poses a closely related inverse problem. Yet it is often addressed with computationally heavy Monte Carlo methods that must be rerun for every new measurement record. Moreover, these methods are restricted to a single inference task, and their cost grows with the state dimension and the record length. To alleviate these restrictions, we interpret Bayesian system identification in hiddem Markov models (HMMs) as a general Bayesian inverse problem, taking advantage of conditional diffusion models. Specifically, a transformer-based diffusion model is trained once on short segments of simulated trajectories to approximate the joint posterior of states and parameters. Through an attention mask induced by the Markov property and a relative time encoding, it can then be deployed on any new measurement record of custom length. At inference time, the same model can flexibly and rapidly be conditioned for joint state and parameter inference, state smoothing, parameter inference, or reconstructing missing measurements, without retraining. We demonstrate these capabilities on four benchmark systems and examine how the length of the training segments affects state and parameter inference. On records five times longer than the training segments, the model maintains its state accuracy, whereas comparison methods either show a more than tenfold error increase or require ten times as much sampling time.

AI.brief_summary: 把 HMM 中的贝叶斯系统辨识当作一般贝叶斯逆问题，在短模拟轨迹段上一次性训练 transformer 扩散模型来近似隐状态与参数的联合后验，并借助 Markov 性质诱导的注意力掩码与相对时间编码，在任意长度的新观测上完成联合推断、状态平滑、参数推断和缺失测量重建。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「短段训练、长记录部署」的摊销后验采样与相对时间编码可为 LVR 中 latent 状态采样、长度泛化与推理期证据使用提供可核查的方法线索，但不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
